{{Quote|Exceptional times call for exceptional measures. One such measure came when the Republic turned to Jedi for political leadership. Jedi Chancellors such as Your Grace have served to guide both the Republic and Order through many a storm.|Jedi Master Vannar Treece, in a report sent to Chancellor Genarra|<ref name="Atlas Extra">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-knight-errant-gazetter|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The Knight Errant Gazetteer|int=The Knight Errant Gazetteer}}</ref>}}
'''Genarra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served as the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the leader of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[New Sith Wars]], circa [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. Following her appointment as Chancellor, Genarra chose not to directly sponsor attacks against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], the enemies of the Republic. However, she did not oppose the activities of [[Vannar Treece]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master who organized expeditions into Sith [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Treece sent Genarra a number of reports, including one that detailed an [[Operation Influx|upcoming mission]] to the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|These are not my Knights, Kerra. You know that. They're on loan, more or less. I owe it to Chancellor Genarra not to waste their lives on a ten-percent plan!|Jedi Master Vannar Treece, to Kerra Holt|<ref name="Influx" />}}
Genarra was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Consular]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="Influx" /> during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the tumultuous [[New Sith Wars]],<ref>''[[Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx]]'' reveals that Genarra was alive in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] that falls within the dates given in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' for the start and end of the [[New Sith Wars]].</ref> a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[New Sith|resurgent Sith]].<ref name="Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Genarra eventually ascended to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]<ref name="Atlas Extra" /> and, by [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]],<ref name="Influx" /> was appointed as leader of both the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the Galactic Republic,<ref name="Knight Errant novel">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref> being one of a series of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to hold the position of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="Influx" /> During her rule, Genarra chose not to directly sponsor large-scale offensives against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] because she believed that the majority of the Republic's populace was fearful of Sith attacks and would not support plans to send large groups of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] on campaigns in Sith [[Realspace/Legends|space]], rather than have the Jedi defend the Republic's frontiers.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

Despite restrictions on such operations, the Jedi Master [[Vannar Treece]] launched numerous expeditions into Sith territories. Genarra did not oppose Treece's activities,<ref name="Knight Errant novel" /> and the Jedi Knight [[Kerra Holt]] regularly sent reports to the Chancellor on Treece's behalf. Circa 1032 BBY,<ref name="Influx" /> Treece began planning a [[Operation Influx|mission]] to take a team of Jedi to raid Sith [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] production facilities in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]], and, in preparation for the operation, he compiled a report for Genarra that outlined the proposed mission and detailed the state of affairs in the Grumani [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Genarra was also forwarded a copy of a briefing given by Holt to the [[Ministry of Defense|Defense Ministry]] on the detailed tactics that were to be used in the mission.<ref name="Atlas Extra" /> Treece's raid did not go according to plan and resulted in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his entire strike team, with the exception of Holt, who was left stranded in the Grumani sector. During her stay in the region, Holt learned a lot of information about the [[Calimondra family|family]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Vilia Calimondra]], and she documented her findings. The [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Jarrow Rusher]] agreed to take the information to the Republic; Holt suggested that, on his arrival in Republic space, Rusher would have a chance to meet Genarra because of the value of the information.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You've got a green lightsaber. An uncommon choice among today's recruits. Do you aspire to become a consular, like Chancellor Genarra?|[[Dorvin Eltrom]], to Kerra Holt|<ref name="Influx" />}}
Genarra was pleased by the results of Vannar Treece's raids because they provided a morale boost for the Republic while using up relatively few [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic military]] resources.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" /> Treece made an effort to ensure that he did not needlessly place at risk the Jedi who participated in his missions, because he believed that he owed it to Genarra to ensure that their lives were not wasted. Genarra carried a green-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]],<ref name="Influx" /> the standard [[Color/Legends|color]] of lightsaber for a Jedi Consular.<ref name="Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Genarra was created by [[John Jackson Miller]] and was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx]]'', a short story that was published on [[StarWars.com]] in [[2010]].<ref name="Influx" /> She subsequently received mentions in the online article [[The Knight Errant Gazetteer|The ''Knight Errant'' Gazetteer]]<ref name="Atlas Extra" /> and Miller's [[2011]] novel, [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']].<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />
